description: Wallet balance on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum or Polygon: native coin balance with USD value (Chainlink) plus up to 10 ERC20 token balances with symbol and decimals. Pass tokens=0xA,0xB. Read live from public RPC. Use before funding, swapping or paying from a wallet. Price $0.002 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"chain":"base","address":"0x0dEA0030A17BF886543a757c55924710258c2eec","native":{"symbol":"ETH","balance":"0.0012","usd":2.78},"tokens":[{"token":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","symbol":"USDC","balance":"1.5"}]}

tokens.description: Optional comma list of up to 10 ERC20 addresses
